## MathLib.zeroFloorSub() function

Returns `x - y`<!-- -->, floored to zero when `y` is greater than or equal to `x`<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
function zeroFloorSub(x: BigIntish, y: BigIntish): bigint;
```
